ui.chatWelcomeMarkdown:
👋 **Welcome to the University Course Timetabling AI Copilot (UCTP)!**

Starting in **Blank Slate mode**. Prepare your data using one of the following:
1. **"✨ Generate Sample"**: Automatically create a realistic dataset with 10 professors, 7 lecture halls/labs, and 25 courses.
2. **"📂 Import CSV"**: Load your own separate CSV files for professors, rooms, and courses (downloadable templates available).

Once loaded, click **"Auto-Schedule Timetable"** to optimize using **WaSHI (HiGHS)**. You can also chat to add custom constraints!

ui.tutorialTitle: 🔰 Quick Guide: 3-Step Walkthrough for AI University Timetabling (UCTP)
ui.step1DescHtml: Prepare faculty, room, and course master data first via 🎲 Generate Samples or 📂 Import CSV (cells can also be edited directly in the tables).
ui.step2DescHtml: Configure academic constraints such as instructor availability, consecutive lab periods, and PC room requirements in the ⚙️ Rules tab or chat.
ui.step2Btn: 🔗 Try: Require "SW Design Lab (2 sessions)" in Consecutive Periods
ui.step3DescHtml: Optimize across 4 cohorts, faculty, and rooms simultaneously. Drag & drop sessions or auto-diagnose infeasible conflicts with WaSHI IIS.
ui.step3SelectAria: Select a conflict scenario to inject
ui.step3Opt1: Demo 1: Pin Tue/Thu-only Adjunct Prof. Kobayashi's course to Mon P3
ui.step3Opt2: Demo 2: Pin two 130+ student Y1 courses both to Tue P2 in Hall 101
ui.step3Opt3: Demo 3: Pin three PC-lab-required courses simultaneously to Mon P2 (only 2 PC labs)

ui.card1Title: 🏛️ 1. Room Capacity, Equipment & Cohort Curriculum Rules
ui.card1Desc: Enable or disable structural physical and curriculum hard constraints in UCTP.
ui.cfgRoomCapHtml: Enforce Room Capacity (Forbid assigning a course to a room smaller than its enrollment)
ui.cfgRoomEquipHtml: Enforce Room Equipment & PC Lab Requirements (Programming/DS labs require PC rooms)
ui.cfgCohortNoOverlapHtml: Forbid Overlap Across All Cohort Courses (Prevent scheduling multiple courses for the same cohort in the same slot)
ui.cfgForbidSameDayHtml: Spread 2-Session Courses Across Different Days (Unless overridden by a consecutive/same-day rule)
ui.card2Title: 👨‍🏫 2. Faculty Availability, Consecutive Caps & Student Hollow Gaps
ui.card2Desc: Configure adjunct day restrictions, faculty meeting NG slots, consecutive lecture caps, and soft penalty weights.
ui.cfgAdjunctDaysHtml: Enforce Adjunct Available Days (Prof. Kobayashi: Tue/Thu only; Prof. Kato: Wed/Fri only)
ui.cfgProfAvailHtml: Enforce Faculty Unavailable Slots (Faculty meetings, committees, medical slots)

ui.nanoDialogTitle: 🤖 Chrome Built-in AI (Gemini Nano) Setup Guide
ui.nanoDialogIntroHtml: The left chat pane uses Chrome's on-device AI (self.LanguageModel API / Gemini Nano).
ui.nanoDialogStep1Html: Open chrome://flags/#optimization-guide-on-device-model and set it to Enabled BypassPerfRequirement.
ui.nanoDialogStep2Html: Open chrome://flags/#prompt-api-for-gemini-nano, set it to Enabled, and relaunch Chrome.
ui.nanoDialogStep3Html: Open chrome://components and click "Check for update" under Optimization Guide On Device Model.
ui.nanoDialogNote: 💡 Even without Gemini Nano enabled, all interactive timetable boards, tutorial steps, rule builders, and WaSHI (HiGHS) optimization & conflict diagnosis work 100% locally.
ui.trajDialogDesc: Complete log of prompts sent to Gemini Nano, JSON Schema constraints, raw JSON outputs, extracted operations, and WaSHI (HiGHS) solve outcomes.
